components.name: Switch

components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-switch::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), width 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 180ms; } .ds-switch:active::after { width: 15px; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"] { background: #fff; box-shadow: none; } .ds-switch[aria-checked="true"]::after { background: #0a0a0c; transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Movie Arena reads like a living-room TV guide seen in a dark room. A near-black canvas holds rows of lit channel tiles. Each streaming site is a channel with its own light and its own lettering, so the catalog looks like a lineup rather than a list of bookmarks. Controls stay quiet and native to Windows so the channels carry the color.

Density is medium. Rows scroll sideways, the billboard gives one pick the full width, and the player strips the chrome down to one slim bar so the video owns the window. Color lives almost entirely inside tiles. Everything outside a tile is neutral, white, or one of three functional signals.

The world rejects the generic bookmark grid of favicons and raw URLs. A site is never shown as a favicon plus a link; it gets a lit tile and a wordmark.
keyCharacteristics: Night canvas (#09090b) with translucent white fills and hairlines for every surface step
White is the only action color; primaries are solid white with near-black text
Per-channel light pools built from each site's own accent pair
Mona Sans wordmarks whose width, weight and case vary per channel, Segoe UI Variable for every control
tvOS-style tile focus: tilt toward the pointer, sheen, lift shadow
Frosted glass only where controls float over lit art

rules.name: The White Voice Rule
rules.body: The only action color is white. A primary control is solid white with On-White Ink; nothing else gets a brand fill.

rules.name: The Borrowed Light Rule
rules.body: Saturated color belongs to channels. It comes from the site's own accent pair and stays inside its tile, billboard or source mark. App chrome never uses a channel's color.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Green means the shield, red means a favorite, coral means destroy. Never reuse a signal color for decoration or for a different meaning.

rules.name: The Channel Lettering Rule
rules.body: A site's wordmark is derived from a hash of its name: width from {78, 88, 100, 112, 122}%, weight from {620, 700, 780, 860}, case as-is, upper or lower. The same name renders the same everywhere. Never set a channel name in Mona Sans by hand with fixed axes; route it through the wordmark.

rules.name: The System Controls Rule
rules.body: Every control, label and paragraph uses the Segoe UI Variable stack. Mona Sans is reserved for channel wordmarks, page titles and the app name.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Ratings, blocked counts, row counts and tallies use tabular numerals so live numbers do not jitter.

rules.name: The Hairline Edge Rule
rules.body: Edges are `inset 0 0 0 1px` white at 8% or 14%, never a solid gray border. Dividers inside panels are a 1px inset line on the top or left.

rules.name: The Lit From Inside Rule
rules.body: Tiles glow from their own light pools and lift on focus. Depth comes from light and soft black shadow, never from a hard offset shadow.

rules.name: The Glass Over Light Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur (12px to 16px, saturate 1.4) is for chips, rating badges, favorite buttons, carousel arrows, row paddles and the frost capsule, all of which float over lit art. Flat chrome on the canvas stays opaque.

dos: Do give every site a lit tile and a hashed Mona Sans wordmark, including user-added links.
Do make the one primary action on a surface solid white (#ffffff) with On-White Ink (#0a0a0c).
Do draw edges as 1px inset white rings at 8% or 14%.
Do align every horizontal edge to the gutter, clamp(24px, 3.2vw, 48px).
Do use Segoe UI Variable for every control and Mona Sans only for wordmarks, page titles and the app name.
Do use tabular numerals for any number that updates live.
Do keep blur for controls that float over lit art.
Do honor reduced motion by removing tilt and animation.
donts: Don't show a site as a favicon plus a URL in a bookmark grid.
Don't use a channel's accent color in app chrome, buttons or text.
Don't use Shield Green, Heart Red or Danger Coral for anything other than the shield, favorites and destructive actions.
Don't introduce a colored primary button; white is the action color.
Don't use solid gray borders or hard offset shadows.
Don't set a channel name in Mona Sans with fixed axes outside the wordmark logic.
